scope: Direct arithmetic comparisons on fresh active-Lean vectors; finite cases, not universal Rust semantics.
inputs: Goldilocks modulus, production B, 32-bit carries, centered signs and u64 conversion boundaries. Extension cases use both basis directions and both signs.
Lean: NightstreamFPrime.Export.FoundationParityMain.emitArithmetic; Fin Goldilocks arithmetic, Spec.K operations and Circuit.Hint.inverse. Nonzero extension inverses are checked against Spec.K.mul.
Rust: neo_math::{Fq, K}; canonical coefficients compared for normalization, add, subtract, multiply, negation, conjugation and inverse (zero maps to zero).
comparison_command: printf the JSON-encoded OUTPUT path to stdin of timeout --signal=KILL 300 cargo test -p neo-math --release --test field_lean_parity -- --ignored --exact active_lean_arithmetic_matches_runtime
digest_scope: File identity only. Arithmetic equality comes from the actual comparisons.
